definitions.explanation: The undergraduate medical faculty at a Japanese university, where students train to become doctors. Notoriously competitive to enter and requires six years of study.

examples.japanese: {医学部|いがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the entrance exam for medical school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東京大学|とうきょうだいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医学部|いがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is enrolled in the medical school at the University of Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {医学部|いがくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違う：01957_chigau⟧、{六年間|ろくねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Unlike other faculties, medical school is a six-year program.

notes:
⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (medicine, medical science) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (faculty, department). In Japan, medicine is studied at the undergraduate level as a faculty of a university, not in a separate graduate school as in the US.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医学部|いがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter medical school
- {医学部|いがくぶ}⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧: medical school entrance exam
- {医学部|いがくぶ}{生|せい}: medical student (= ⟦{医学生|いがくせい}→医学生：27621_igakusei⟧)
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧{医学部|いがくぶ}: national-university medical school

CULTURAL NOTE:
Getting into {医学部|いがくぶ} is one of the most competitive academic challenges in Japan, with very high entrance-exam hurdles. Becoming a doctor (⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧) requires completing the six-year program and passing the national licensing exam.

RELATED FACULTIES:
- {歯学部|しがくぶ}: faculty of dentistry
- ⟦{薬学部|やくがくぶ}→薬学部：28157_yakugakubu⟧: faculty of pharmacy
- {看護学部|かんごがくぶ}: faculty of nursing
